summary: Verified DP Merch order-status polling + deep-link return patch. All 5 UI flows and the direct 404 curl check pass. No regressions on Main Menu or merch storefront. Backend order-status endpoint returns real 404 as documented. No console.log leaks of status_token/checkoutUrl in changed files.
tests_performed: Main Menu regression: DRUNK PIGEONS, MERCH, PLAY, PIGEONS, LEADERBOARD, drunkness slider, manor tiles all render (PASS)

Full merch flow: MERCH -> 5 product list -> The Fancy Hoodie detail -> size S -> live quote (Subtotal £85, Shipping £4.99, Total £89.99) -> email entered -> BUY NOW -> 'Checkout is temporarily unavailable — please check back soon.' shown (503, PASS). window.localStorage['dp_pendingMerchOrder'] === null after 503 (PASS: no stray pending order on failure)

Seeded LS with fake {orderId, statusToken}, navigated to /?merch_status=success&order_id=fake-order-id: real 404 from backend, UI resolves to merch-return-unavailable ('WE CAN'T CONFIRM THIS RIGHT NOW' + support@intiesltd.com message), no raw 404/stack trace, no 'ORDER CONFIRMED' shown, localStorage cleared (PASS)
BACK TO STORE (merch-return-done) from unavailable state returns cleanly to merch store screen, no overlay leftover, no crash (PASS)

DEV: PREVIEW ORDER-CONFIRMED SCREEN (merch-dev-preview-return) shows merch-return-confirmed instantly with 'DEV PREVIEW — NOT A REAL ORDER' tag and no API calls (PASS). BACK TO STORE from this state also works (PASS)
?merch_status=cancel with no pending LS shows merch-return-unavailable (correct: nothing to poll) (PASS)
Code grep: no console.log in merchApi.js, checkoutClient.js, MerchProductScreen.js, MerchReturnOverlay.js, persistence.js, merchDeepLinks.js (PASS)
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In MerchReturnOverlay.js line 53, if payment_status stays 'pending' AND deep-link status==='cancel', the code short-circuits to 'cancelled' after the first poll — behavior matches spec but relies on the poll running at least once for cancel; acceptable given a cancel with a real pending order is a valid state.
Minor observation: several deprecation console warnings in the app ('shadow*'/'textShadow*'/'pointerEvents') — pre-existing, unrelated to this patch.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test 2 seeded window.localStorage.dp_pendingMerchOrder with fake ids; the app itself cleared it during the flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Merch order-status + polling deep-link return flow is fully working. Backend /api/merch/checkout-sessions is still a real 503 (Stripe key not configured server-side) — expected. Do not attempt real payments.
